# Toolora

Toolora is a free online tools website offering browser-based tools for images, PDFs, text, calculators, QR codes, and file conversion.

## Image Tools

* [Image Compressor](https://toolora-inky.vercel.app/image-compressor)
* [Image Resizer](https://toolora-inky.vercel.app/image-resizer)
* [JPG to PNG](https://toolora-inky.vercel.app/jpg-to-png)

## PDF Tools

* [PDF Compressor](https://toolora-inky.vercel.app/pdf-compressor)
* [JPG to PDF](https://toolora-inky.vercel.app/jpg-to-pdf)
* [PDF to JPG](https://toolora-inky.vercel.app/pdf-to-jpg)

## Text Tools

* [Word Counter](https://toolora-inky.vercel.app/word-counter)

## Calculators

* [Percentage Calculator](https://toolora-inky.vercel.app/percentage-calculator)
* [Age Calculator](https://toolora-inky.vercel.app/age-calculator)
* [BMI Calculator](https://toolora-inky.vercel.app/bmi-calculator)

## Other Tools

* [QR Code Generator](https://toolora-inky.vercel.app/qr-code-generator)

## Website Information

* [Home](https://toolora-inky.vercel.app/)
* [About Toolora](https://toolora-inky.vercel.app/about)
* [Contact](https://toolora-inky.vercel.app/contact)
* [Privacy Policy](https://toolora-inky.vercel.app/privacy-policy)
* [Disclaimer](https://toolora-inky.vercel.app/disclaimer)

## Usage

Toolora's online tools are designed to be simple and accessible through a web browser. Users can access the available tools directly from their respective pages.
